name: @swasthyasetu/core
comment: ZERO DEPENDENCIES, DELIBERATELY. This package runs unchanged on a phone (Hermes) and on the server. Adding any dependency - including node:* builtins - breaks offline triage. See AGENTS.md section 6. Node runs the .ts sources directly by stripping types, which is why there is no build step and why relative imports must end in .ts (AGENTS.md section 3).
